m: पुदक m. pl. N. of a people, VP.

s: puM, (pUraRAt put galanAt galaH । tataH karmmaDArayaH । vfdDihnAsavattvAddehasya taTAtvam .) dehaH । (yaTA, pArSvanATacarite । 12 । 110 । “cakruH Sirasi BAle ca netre sarvvANgapudgale ॥”) AtmA । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ paramARuH । yaTA, -- “sTUlA maDyAstaTA sUkzmAH sUkzmAt sUkzmatarASca ye । dehaBedA BavAn sarvve ye kecit pudgalASrayAH ॥” iti vizRupurARe 5 aMSe 20 aDyAyaH ॥ “pUryyante galanti ceti pudgalAH । vfdDyapakzayaBAjo ye'vayavAstadASrayA dehaBedAH । yaTAhuH । pUraRAdgalanAddehe pudgalAH paramARava iti .” iti tawwIkAyAM SrIDarasvAmI ॥
tri, (put vardDanaSIlaH galo hnAsavAMSceti karmmaDArayaH .) sundarAkAraH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ rUpAdimaddravyam । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: pu॰ pUraRAt put galatIti galaH karma॰ । 1 paramARO “pUraRAdgalanAt dehe pudgalAH paramARavaH” iti vizRupu॰ wIkAyAM SrIDaraDftavAkyam । 2 bOdDamataprasidDe dvyaRukAdipadArTaBede ca । put kutsito galo yasmAt । 3 sundarAkAre tri॰ Sabdara॰ । 3 rUpAdiviSizwe tri॰ hemaca॰
m: पुद्गल mf(आ)n. beautiful, lovely, handsome, MārkP.
पुद्गल m. the body, Hit. i, 41 v.l.
(with Jainas) material object (including atoms), Śaṃk.; MWB. 535
the Ego or individual (in a disparaging sense), SaddhP.
N. of Śiva, MBh. (= देह, Nīlak.)
a horse of the colour of rock-crystal, Gal.
a: पुद्गल — a. Beautiful, lovely, handsome. --लः 1 An atom (परमाणुः); पुद्गलाः परम णवः Śrīdhara. --2 The body, matter. --3 The soul. --4 An epithet of Śiva.

m: पुद्गल—पति m. a prince, king, Var.
